chr.description: Chromosome the variant lies on, prefixed with 'chr', for example chr1.

pos.description: Position of the variant on the chromosome, 0-based.

rsid.description: dbSNP reference SNP identifiers for this allele, for example rs6054257. An array because several rsIDs can normalize to the same allele.

ref.description: Reference allele sequence at this position, empty for a pure insertion.

alt.description: Alternate allele sequence, empty for a pure deletion.

qual.description: Variant call quality score carried over from the QUAL column of the source VCF, for example 50110.4.

variation_type.description: Class of sequence change, derived by comparing the reference and alternate allele lengths: SNP, insertion, deletion, or deletion-insertion.

annotations.description: Source-specific annotations parsed from the INFO column of the source VCF, including population allele frequencies keyed by cohort such as topmed and korea1k.

spdi.description: Normalized SPDI expression identifying the allele, written as RefSeq accession, 0-based position, deleted sequence and inserted sequence, for example NC_000001.11:10887495:C:T.

hgvs.description: HGVS genomic expression for the allele, for example NC_000067.7:g.3050715_3050716insG.

vrs_digest.description: GA4GH Variation Representation Specification allele digest, a hash that is stable across equivalent representations of the same allele.

ca_id.description: Canonical allele identifier assigned by the ClinGen Allele Registry.

organism.description: Species the variant was called in, either Homo sapiens against GRCh38 or Mus musculus against GRCm39.
